name: Part D Prescription Fills
description: One row per Part D prescription fill, with the PDE fields and the drug's RxNorm concept, name, strength, dose form and active ingredients. Active ingredients are RxNorm ingredients or precise ingredients, given as two lists in the same order, so a combination drug stays a single row. The data is available from 2016 to 2018.

content.pde_id: VARCHAR: Unique identifier of the Part D event (prescription fill) for a beneficiary. ResDAC PDE variable: PDE_ID
content.bene_id: VARCHAR: CCW encrypted beneficiary ID. The same for a person across all CCW files and years, so it links fills to the MBSF and MedPAR. ResDAC PDE variable: BENE_ID
content.rx_service_date: DATE: Date the prescription was filled. ResDAC PDE variable: SRVC_DT
content.year: BIGINT: Calendar year of the fill
content.product_service_id: VARCHAR: National Drug Code (NDC) of the dispensed product, 11 digits: 5-digit labeler, 4-digit product (ingredient, strength, dose form and route) and 2-digit package code. For a compound, the NDC of its most expensive ingredient. ResDAC PDE variable: PROD_SRVC_ID
content.qty_dispensed_num: DOUBLE: Quantity dispensed, in units, grams, milliliters or other units depending on the dose form. For a compound, the total of all ingredients; for a partial fill, the total amount prescribed. ResDAC PDE variable: QTY_DSPNSD_NUM
content.days_suply_num: DOUBLE: Number of days' supply dispensed by the pharmacy (0 to 999). ResDAC PDE variable: DAYS_SUPLY_NUM
content.fill_num: DOUBLE: Fill number of this dispensed supply (0 to 99); 0 is the original fill and 1 the first refill. ResDAC PDE variable: FILL_NUM
content.drug_coverage_status: VARCHAR: Whether the drug is covered by Part D. C = covered; E = supplemental drug, reported by plans with enhanced alternative coverage; O = over-the-counter. ResDAC PDE variable: DRUG_CVRG_STUS_CD
content.brnd_gnrc_cd: VARCHAR: Whether the plan adjudicated the claim as a brand (B) or generic (G) drug. Reported for covered drugs only; otherwise blank. ResDAC PDE variable: BRND_GNRC_CD
content.drug_rxcui: VARCHAR: RxNorm concept ID of the dispensed drug, matched from the NDC: a clinical drug (SCD), branded drug (SBD) or pack (GPCK / BPCK)
content.drug_name: VARCHAR: RxNorm name of the drug, e.g. carbidopa 25 MG / levodopa 100 MG Oral Tablet. Branded drugs end with the brand in brackets; packs list their contents in braces
content.dosage_strength: VARCHAR: Strength of the drug from RxNorm, e.g. 25 MG / 100 MG; patches are per hour, e.g. 0.396 MG/HR. Blank for packs
content.dose_form: VARCHAR: RxNorm dose form of the drug, e.g. Oral Tablet, Oral Solution, Pack
content.ingredient_rxcuis: VARCHAR[]: RxNorm IDs of the drug's active ingredients (ingredient IN or precise ingredient PIN). Brand names are never included; a pack lists the ingredients of everything it contains
content.ingredient_names: VARCHAR[]: Names of the drug's active ingredients, in the same order as ingredient_rxcuis
